values.note: City of Adair: campers and motor homes $20 a night, tents $6; dump station only $5. Pay by envelope at the drop box at the restroom/shower house. Read 2026-11-03.

values.note: Closes during freezing temperatures, approximately November-April; the bathhouse and restrooms are locked in winter, though hydrants, electricity and the dump station are listed as available year-round (contact City Hall about conditions).

note: City of Adair park campground just north of I-80 Exit 76, immediately past the bridge on the east side; gravel pads, playground and ball fields. Bring a splitter for the water hookups. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 campers/motor homes (tents $6), 50-amp (four sites; rest 30) with water, FCFS only, showers and dump, closed in freezing weather ~Nov-Apr. Cleared the unsourced site count (8) and back-in flag: the city states neither. Waterfront not waterfront fine (in-town park, no water).
flags: Missing phone: the city page gives 'Adair City Hall: 641-742-3751' (Mon-Thu 8-2, Fri 8-noon). apply.py doesn't write phone.

Pin: NAIP shows the city park's loop drive just north of the railroad bridge on the east side of the road, matching the city's directions; the pin sits at the park's south entrance (fine). No pads or RVs can be told apart on the imagery, so no site count from it.
